items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: Lionel Hampton and Teddy Wilson had been with Benny Goodman

ctx.x: Do you recall -- it says in 'DownBeat' that, actually, that before Warner took on some black musicians, they had never appeared in the studios -- in the broadcasting studios. Do you remember anything like that?
No, I don't remember that. I mean, after all, you've got to remember that prior to that time, Lionel Hampton and Teddy Wilson had been with Benny Goodman, and ...
